A later block-reduction argument also establishes additive positive effective retained bundles, including when one bundle is retained-only. An earlier note denied that stronger implication; its author's response remained pending. The textual disagreement concerns retained additivity, rather than the agreed determinant decomposition. changes.after: Omission alone need not break the spring representation. On the same positive-definite internal coordinate space at all four corners, with fixed minima, offsets, configurational measures and kinetic terms and prescribed additive positive bundles, exact zero conditional cross-compliance \(U_w^TD_{00}^{-1}V_w=0\) is a sufficient condition for additive positive effective retained bundles after Schur reduction. This includes the case where one bundle is retained-only, and also permits both bundles to touch omitted coordinates. Under this condition the omitted determinant cycle vanishes, so the full and retained stiffness cycles agree. A merely small conditional information does not imply this exact additive representation. These sufficient fixed-space conditions do not validate chemical replacements.\footnote{Retained derivation: \texttt{emmy/marginal-bounds.md}, fixed-space assumptions and exact bundle reduction; joint entries 25 and 29. The retained synthetic checks corroborate the algebra, not molecular correspondence.}
